name: Burning Incense
overview: Scripture reveals that burning incense was a sacred act commanded by God, symbolizing worship and prayer directed to Him, as seen in Aaron's daily offering of sweet incense (Exodus 30:7) and the requirement to avoid unauthorized or strange incense (Exodus 30:9; Leviticus 10:1). The incense was closely associated with holiness and the presence of God, especially within the tabernacle, where it was used in specific rituals such as on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:12). Additionally, the psalmist likens prayer to incense rising to God (Psalms 141:2), and Malachi prophesies that incense offerings will honor God's name among the nations, highlighting its enduring significance in worship (Malachi 1:11).
